user.title: Select Gas Company
user.description: Select your gas company from the list below.

auth_code.title: Sign in with authCode
auth_code.description: Paste the raw capture content — the accessToekn request URL or full request text, or the redirect page URL (like .../transitionPage/index?code=xxx). The authCode is extracted automatically. You may also paste the bare authCode. Selected company: {org_name}. Leave sign empty to have it computed automatically.

data.auth_code: authCode (paste the whole request is fine)

auth_token.title: Enter Authentication Info
auth_token.description: Enter the access_token and the refresh_token from the same response. Selected company: {org_name}. Leave sign empty to have it computed automatically (recommended); refresh_token is recommended, otherwise the access_token expires in about 2 hours with no renewal.

select_subs.title: Select Gas Accounts
select_subs.description: Select the gas accounts (meters) to add. Each account will be a separate device.

reauth_code.title: Sign in with a new authCode
reauth_code.description: Paste the raw capture content and the authCode is extracted automatically. Company: {org_name}. Leave sign empty to have it computed automatically.

data.auth_code: authCode (paste the whole request is fine)

reauth_confirm.title: Re-enter tokens
reauth_confirm.description: Please re-enter the access_token and refresh_token (sign may be left empty). Company: {org_name}

error.auth_failed: Authentication failed. Please check your access_token and refresh_token, or use the authCode method instead.
error.token_refresh_failed: The access_token has expired and could not be renewed with the refresh_token. Check that the refresh_token is correct and has not been invalidated by a new login, or use the authCode method. Details from the server have been written to the HA log.
error.no_mobile: The API call succeeded but returned no mobile number, so the account could not be identified. Check the sign, or use the authCode method.
error.auth_rejected: The server rejected this authentication. The full response has been written to the HA log.
error.auth_code_invalid: The authCode is invalid or already used (WeChat authorization codes are single-use and expire in 5 minutes). Please obtain a new one.
error.no_subs_selected: Please select at least one gas account.
error.connect_error: Connection failed. Please check your network.

abort.orglist_load_failed: Failed to load orglist.json. Please check the file exists.

init.title: Reconfigure
init.description: Update your tokens and sign if they have expired. You can also adjust the data refresh interval.
